dedupe_keys.name: escap world bank international trade costs

description: ESCAP-World Bank: International Trade Costs is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Agriculture, Economics and prices", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). The Trade Costs Dataset provides estimates of bilateral trade costs in agriculture and manufactured goods for the 1995-2018 period. It is built on trade and production data collected in 208 countries. Symmetric bilateral trade costs are computed using the Inverse Gravity Framework (Nov. Coverage: East Asia and the Pacific. It has 1 file. The portal files it under Agriculture, Economics and prices. The portal gives 2013 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
